Hong Kong's trade watched a mainland gold chain's shelves empty at a fire-sale price today, its founders still missing.

Beijing Qianye Jewelry (NEEQ: 833585) is clearing stock at RMB990 a gram; one customer bought 30-plus pieces, and staff say the till system crashed. The stock is down 42% this week, 93% this year.

香港金飾業界關注：北京千葉珠寶（新三板代碼833585）多家門店以低至每克人民幣990元清倉甩賣；有顧客一次購入逾30件，店員稱開單系統已癱瘓。其股價本週累跌42%，年內累跌93%，實控人林明杰夫婦仍下落不明。
